settings.heading: CARBON-FREE CRAFT: REDUCING OUR ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT, ONE RUG AT A TIME

settings.text:
At Indian Rug Store, we apply Carbon-Free Craft in every piece of rug we make. Sustainability should be at the core of any craft, so we make it our point to reduce carbon emissions throughout the production of our rugs. From source material selection to using renewable energy in facilities, we actively reduce carbon footprints with each of our rugs.

Our Carbon-Free Craft approach, based on innovation and being responsible, ensures that creation of every single rug that we make adds to the cleaner, greener planet. We revisit our process continually with the aim of minimizing not just the waste but also low-energy usage while at the same time maintaining overall highest standards in every design piece.

We are indeed aware that our future tomorrow depends on the decisions made today. This is one of the reasons why we are committed to proactive efforts toward a carbon-free future in reducing our carbon emissions and ensuring we go about environmentally friendly practices. We're aiding in the protection of the environment while creating beautiful, sustainable rugs that our customers can be proud of.At Indian Rug Store, we are proud to lead by example in the effort to reduce environmental impact. Carbon-Free Craft is more than just a goal—it's our ongoing commitment to sustainability and the preservation of the world we all share. Together, we can weave a better future, one rug at a time.

settings.title: CRAFTING A CARBON-FREE FUTURE
settings.text: With each rug, we commit ourselves to reducing our carbon footprint in producing eco-friendly materials and adopting energy-efficient production methods. Sustainability is woven into every design.

settings.title: RUGS WITH PURPOSE
settings.text: We make beauty without hurting the earth. Our Carbon-Free Craft way ensures that every hand-tufted rug has little environmental impact by reducing its carbon footprint stitch after stitch.

settings.title: WEAVING A GREENER TOMORROW
settings.text: We make luxurious rugs that are a contribution to a cleaner, carbon-free world by embracing renewable energy, sustainable materials, and efficient manufacturing.
